description: This file defines a C# class named Cookies that provides methods to interact with browser cookies via JavaScript interop in a Blazor application.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class providing methods to delete and retrieve cookies asynchronously through JavaScript interop.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by its name asynchronously.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie by its name asynchronously.
